name: Study Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Must be accepted by an institution licensed by Malta's National Commission for Higher Education to pursue a full-time course of study leading to a higher-education qualification at MQF level 5 or above.
requirements.fix_path: Secure acceptance to a licensed full-time MQF5+ programme.

evidence_required.document: Letter of acceptance from an MQF5+-licensed institution
Passport valid at least 8 months at submission
Proof of sufficient financial means (exact threshold not published at tier-1)
Health insurance (commonly required; not detailed at tier-1 in this pass)

outcome.duration_length: tied to course duration, typically issued and renewed annually for multi-year programmes

sources.title: Identità -- Expatriates Unit: Study, Research, Trainees, Volunteers & Interns permits, enrollment requirement, travel document validity, EUR50 fee

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Malta's initial build. Only the enrollment requirement is confirmed at tier-1 in this pass -- the tier-1 page did not detail financial-means thresholds, health insurance specifics, permit duration, part-time work-hour limits, or family-member provisions (these are commonly covered by the EU Students Directive 2016/801 as transposed into Maltese subsidiary legislation, but the exact figures were not independently confirmed here). work_rights set to 'restricted' as an inference consistent with the EU student-work pattern (limited part-time hours), not independently confirmed at tier-1. family_can_join set false because student sponsors are not confirmed to qualify family reunification under the family-members policy reviewed for mt_family_reunification. Application fee EUR50 (volunteers exempt); visa-exempt nationals must apply for a National Visa within 3 months of Schengen entry if the course exceeds 90 days.
